## RNAseq
```{r}
# load RNA-seq data
rna.expression <- readr::read_tsv(
  file.path("../../data/RNA_PRESTO_RV/", "20200427_103972-001_rawcounts.txt"),
  col_types = readr::cols(),
) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Gene")

pheno.data <- full.pheno.data[
  full.pheno.data$GenomeScan_ID_RNAseq %in% colnames(rna.expression),]
print(pheno.data)

rna.expression <- rna.expression[,pheno.data$GenomeScan_ID_RNAseq]
print(dim(rna.expression))

```
```{r}
gtf <- read.table('../../docs/genes.gtf', header = FALSE, skip = 5, sep = "\t")
genes.info <- gtf[gtf$V3 == "gene", ]
colnames(genes.info) <- c(
  "seqname", "source", "feature", "start", "end", 
  "score", "strand", "frame", "attribute"
)

df <- as_tibble(str_split_fixed(genes.info$attribute, ';', 7))
ENS.ID <- as_tibble(str_split_fixed(df$V1, ' ', 2))$V2
gene.symbol <- as_tibble(str_split_fixed(df$V4, ' ', 3))$V3

genes.info$ENS.ID <- ENS.ID
genes.info$gene.symbol <- gene.symbol
genes.info$attribute <- NULL
head(genes.info)

AGER <- genes.info %>%
          filter(gene.symbol == "AGER")
AGER
```
# 

```{r}
common_samples <- intersect(colnames(rna.expression), 
                            pheno.data$GenomeScan_ID_RNAseq)

# Subset data to common samples
rna.expression <- rna.expression[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]
pheno.data <- pheno.data %>%
  dplyr::filter(GenomeScan_ID_RNAseq %in% common_samples) %>%
  arrange(match(GenomeScan_ID_RNAseq, common_samples)) %>%
  as.data.frame()
  
# Filter low-expressed genes
keep_genes <- rowSums(rna.expression > 0) >= 0.2 * ncol(rna.expression)
rna.expression <- rna.expression[keep_genes, , drop = FALSE]

# EdgeR processing
DGEL <- edgeR::DGEList(rna.expression)

# Remove samples with zero library size
keep_samples <- colSums(DGEL$counts) > 0
if (any(!keep_samples)) {
  message("Removing ", sum(!keep_samples), " samples with zero library size")
  DGEL <- DGEL[, keep_samples]
  }
  
# Skip if insufficient samples remain
if (ncol(DGEL) < 3) {
  message("Insufficient samples after filtering (", ncol(DGEL), ")")
  return(NULL)
  }
  
# Calculate normalization factors
DGEL <- calcNormFactors(DGEL, method = "TMM")
logCPM <- cpm(DGEL, log = TRUE, prior.count = 3)

AGER <- "ENSG00000204305"
AGER.rna.expression <- logCPM[AGER, , drop = FALSE]

```



```{r}
GEX.df <- data.frame(
  GenomeScan_ID_RNAseq = colnames(AGER.rna.expression),
  gene.expression = as.numeric(AGER.rna.expression),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Merge all data
merged.data <- pheno.data %>%
  left_join(GEX.df, by = "GenomeScan_ID_RNAseq")

df = snp.data %>%

```{r}
# Create the swarm plot
library(ggbeeswarm)

# Modified plotting code with better debugging
plot.data <- df %>%
  # Remove rows with missing critical data
  filter(!is.na(genotype.formatted)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(gene.expression)) %>%
  # Create condition variable - adjust based on what you found in the debug
  mutate(condition = case_when(
    Group_simple == "SEO-COPD" ~ "SEO-COPD",
    Group_simple %in% c("Control", "NS_Ctrl") ~ "Control",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(condition))  # Remove any remaining NA conditions

plot.data$genotype.formatted <- factor(
  plot.data$genotype.formatted,
  levels = c("GG", "GA", "AG")  # desired order
)

print(
  paste0("Plot data dimensions after filtering: ", paste(dim(plot.data), collapse = ",")))
head(plot.data)
```


```{r}
box.plot <- ggplot(
  plot.data,
  aes(x = genotype.formatted, y = gene.expression, fill = condition)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    alpha = 0.9,
    outlier.shape = NA,  # Hide outliers since we'll show all points
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_quasirandom( 
    aes(color = "black"),
    dodge.width = 0.8,
    alpha = 0.9,
    size = 4,
    shape = 21,             # shape 21 = circle with fill and border
    color = "black",        # border (outline) color
    stroke = 1.2
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Gene expression Levels by Genotype",
    subtitle = "Gene: AGER",
    x = "Genotype",
    y = "Gene expression Value (logCPM)",
    fill = "Condition",
    color = "Condition"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("SEO-COPD" = "#E41A1C", "Control" = "#377EB8")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("SEO-COPD" = "#E41A1C", "Control" = "#377EB8")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 18),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
    axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8),  # show x-axis line
    axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8),  # show x-axis line
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "top",
    panel.grid = element_blank()   # Remove grid lines
  )

filename <- file.path(result.dir, "boxplot_AGER_gene_expression_snp.svg")
# Save the combined plot as SVG
ggsave(
  filename = filename,
  plot = box.plot,
  device = "svg",
  width = 5,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300
)
```

# Pie chart
## Prepare data for pie chart

```{r}
# Prepare the data correctly
pie.data <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(genotype.formatted) & !is.na(Group_simple)) %>%
  filter(Group_simple %in% c("Control", "SEO-COPD")) %>%
  # Remove TT genotype first
  filter(genotype.formatted != "AA") %>%
  # Count genotypes by group
  group_by(Group_simple, genotype.formatted) %>%
  summarise(n_count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  # Ensure all genotypes are present for both groups
  complete(Group_simple, genotype.formatted = c("GG", "GA"), fill = list(n_count = 0)) %>%
  # Calculate percentages WITHOUT TT
  group_by(Group_simple) %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(n_count),  # This total excludes TT
    percentage = ifelse(n_count > 0, round(n_count / total * 100, 1), 0),
    label = ifelse(n_count > 0, paste0(genotype.formatted, "\n", n_count, " (", percentage, "%)"), "")
  )

print("Final pie data:")
print(pie.data)
```

```{r}
# Create the donut plot function
make_donut <- function(data, title) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = 2, y = percentage, fill = genotype.formatted)) +
    geom_col(color = "white", width = 1) +
    coord_polar(theta = "y", start = 0) +
    xlim(0.5, 2.5) +  # creates the donut hole
    geom_text(aes(label = label),
              position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
              size = 4, color = "white") +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
    theme_void() +
    ggtitle(title) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}

# Filter and plot for each group
p1 <- make_donut(pie.data %>% filter(Group_simple == "Control"), "Control Group")
p2 <- make_donut(pie.data %>% filter(Group_simple == "SEO-COPD"), "SEO-COPD Group")

# Display both plots side by side
library(patchwork)
final.donut.plot <- p1 + p2

filename <- file.path(result.dir, "donut_chart_AGER_gene_expression_snp.svg")
# Save the combined plot as SVG
ggsave(
  filename = filename,
  plot = final.donut.plot,
  device = "svg",
  width = 10,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
# Load libraries
library(ggbeeswarm)

# Swarm plot with group means
plot <- ggplot(plot.data, aes(x = genotype.formatted, y = gene.expression, color = condition)) +
  
  # Swarm points
  geom_beeswarm(
    dodge.width = 0.8,
    alpha = 0.7,
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  # Horizontal line for the mean of each group-condition combination
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "crossbar",
    aes(group = condition),
    color = "black",
    width = 0.6,
    fatten = 1,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Gene expression Levels by Genotype",
    subtitle = "Gene: AGER",
    x = "Genotype",
    y = "Gene expression Value (logCPM)",
    fill = "Condition",
    color = "Condition"
  ) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = c("SEO-COPD" = "#E41A1C", "Control" = "#377EB8")) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 18),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 14),
    panel.grid = element_blank()   # Remove grid lines
  )

filename <- file.path(result.dir, "swarm_plot_with_means.svg")

# Save the swarm plot with means as SVG
ggsave(
  filename = filename,
  plot = plot,
  device = "svg",
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
